description: VN→ZH localizer position transfer: Vietnamese localizers PRECEDE the noun ('trên bàn' = on-table), while Mandarin postposes them (桌子上). Learners drop the trailing localizer and write '在桌子'. Rule zh-locative-localizer appends the postposed localizer for a closed place-noun set after 在.
fp_risk_note: Low risk. Scoped to a closed noun→localizer map (桌子/床/墙 → 上; 盒子/抽屉 → 里) after 在. Abstains when a localizer is already present ('在桌子上') via the trailing lookahead, and on place nouns that need no localizer ('在学校', '在家'), which are simply not in the map.

positive.notes: 在桌子 → 在桌子上 (append 上).
在床 → 在床上 (append 上).
在盒子 → 在盒子里 (append 里).

negative.notes: Localizer 上 already present — the lookahead blocks it, must abstain.
学校 (school) needs no localizer and is not in the map — must abstain.
家 (home) needs no localizer and is not in the map — must abstain.
